dialogues.value: Good job getting to the planet safely Investigator 305. You have entered the suspected zone of the last signs of life. Navigate the area carefully and see what you can find.
We are monitoring your progress from up here With some beacons we sent down earlier. You should try to get as many as you can on your exploration.
Space Gov is granting you special pay based on the areas you've explored when you collect a beacon.
Copy that Captain. Deckhardt over and out.
This must be one of the beacons the captain mentioned.
Beacon detected! updating ground exploration progress. Updating credits. Thank you for your service, 305.
Oh, look at that. My credits are in the top right hand corner. Didn't notice that.
Our systems show you've made some decent progress. Could you hurry it up a little?
Well I'm the one doing all the work here Captain. It'd go faster if you actually did something.
Well we've sent down some extra gas for you to use along the way. Should give you a nice boost for your pump action pack you've got.
Oh hey, 305! Over here! In the little bin. We sent down a vendor for you to use. Its got everything you need but not on company credit.
You're going to need a bigger jump pack if you want to continue, so you've got to pay the toll fee.
You can buy one for 200 credits. I hope you've got enough.
Well there goes all my pay for this job.
